# Lab 13.2: AI.GENERATE: Text & Structured Output

## What We Are Going to Do
Summarise movie reviews with AI.GENERATE, then extract several typed fields at once with `output_schema`.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Save a small sample to keep costs low.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab13.reviews AS
SELECT movie_id, title, review, reviewer_rating
FROM `bigquery-public-data.imdb.reviews`
WHERE review IS NOT NULL AND title IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 50;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Free-text output.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title,
  AI.GENERATE(CONCAT('Summarise this movie review in one sentence: ', review)).result AS summary
FROM lab13.reviews
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Structured output.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  title,
  reviewer_rating,
  AI.GENERATE(
    CONCAT('Analyse this movie review: ', review),
    output_schema =&gt; '''
      sentiment STRING OPTIONS(description = "positive, negative or mixed"),
      score INT64 OPTIONS(description = "1 to 10"),
      mentions_acting BOOL,
      key_points ARRAY&lt;STRING&gt;'''
  ).* EXCEPT (full_response, status)
FROM lab13.reviews
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Compare with the real rating.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT reviewer_rating,
  AI.GENERATE(CONCAT('Rate this review from 1 to 10: ', review), output_schema =&gt; 'score INT64').score AS ai_score
FROM lab13.reviews
WHERE reviewer_rating IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 20;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Look at the full response.** Select `AI.GENERATE(...)` without `.result`. The struct has `result`, `full_response` (with token counts and safety info) and `status` (empty when the call succeeded).

6. **[CLI] Call AI.GENERATE from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
"SELECT title, AI.GENERATE(CONCAT('Give this review a 3-word headline: ', review)).result AS headline FROM lab13.reviews LIMIT 3"</span>
</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `.result` | Plain text answer |
| `output_schema` | Typed columns: STRING, INT64, BOOL, ARRAY |
| `status` | Empty on success, error text otherwise |
| Cost control | Work on a small saved sample |
